name: herdr-brain
description: Herdr Monitor: a durable record of work items, runs, reports and zero-inference status outside any LLM session.

scripts.test:promotion: node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion -- npm run test:promotion:steps
scripts.test: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:cycle --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:cycle
scripts.test:promotion:steps: npm run test:slot && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:core --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:core && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:lanes --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:lanes && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:promotion:logic --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:promotion:logic
scripts.test:promotion:logic: node test/helpers/run.mjs --test-name-pattern='^(measured load|a loaded native lookup|the default native executor|the record lock|exhausted record-lock|exhausted, refused|a replacement PID|slow Herdr|housekeeping gives|queue and notice locks|inbox fixture teardown|owned inbox teardown|(?:exhausted|refused) (?:start|prepare|commit) replies|loaded transaction|(?:claude|codex): captured ANSI|compound styles|Codex includes|interruption requires|repository does not track|cleanup closes main and linked workspaces after|failed inventory still attempts every owned receipt|unreceipted scratch workspace|cleanup recovers implicit main and linked workspaces|a malformed journal entry|cleanup reconciles again when a lost-reply workspace|a matching caller label with a foreign native path|(?:fake watcher receipt|real watcher journal) refuses PID reuse|conflicting agent tab/workspace|supported review routes need|every terminal condition has a distinct)' test/load-deadlines.test.mjs settle/test/ref-deadlines.test.mjs supervisor/test/delivery.test.mjs housekeeping/test/housekeeping.test.mjs supervisor/test/entry.test.mjs acceptance/test/cleanup.test.mjs acceptance/test/focus.test.mjs acceptance/test/recovery.test.mjs dispatch/test/dispatch-options.test.mjs housekeeping/test/auto-tidy.test.mjs watch/test/watch.test.mjs
scripts.test:release:steps: npm test && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:lanes --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:lanes && node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:acceptance --retry-timeout-under-load -- npm run test:acceptance && npm run test:release:only
scripts.test:promotion:lanes: node test/helpers/run.mjs --test-name-pattern='^(promote (refuses|leaves|rebases|accepts)|close (deletes|retires|refuses|preserves)|open refuses (symlink|ordinary)|registered paths are rejected|same-named repositories|a repository with a separate git directory|failed archive and post-close metadata|selected malformed, unreadable, and wrongly typed config|linked invocations use canonical repository config|bare repositories with only linked worktrees)' lanes/test/lane.test.mjs
scripts.test:release: node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:release -- npm run test:release:steps
scripts.test:release:only: node test-slot/test-slot.mjs run test:release:only -- node test/helpers/release-suites.mjs
